meta.description: Complete guide for WeChat Mini Program authentication with CloudBase - native login, user identity, and cloud function integration.

copy.tagline: 集成微信小程序云开发登录与用户身份认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发微信小程序并需要实现云开发登录功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat Mini Program login with CloudBase authentication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a WeChat Mini Program and need to implement CloudBase authentication.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会指导你完成微信小程序与CloudBase的认证集成：自动初始化CloudBase、在云函数中获取用户身份（openid等）、并处理授权逻辑。
howto.when: 当你询问如何实现微信小程序登录、获取用户身份（如openid）、或集成CloudBase认证时触发。

say.text: 帮我在小程序app.js中初始化CloudBase。
写一个云函数，返回当前用户的openid。
测试小程序认证是否正常。
say.note: Claude会给出测试云函数和调用代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through WeChat Mini Program authentication with CloudBase: initializing CloudBase, retrieving user identity (openid, etc.) in cloud functions, and handling authorization logic.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for WeChat Mini Program login, user identity retrieval (e.g., openid), or CloudBase authentication integration.

say_en.text: Initialize CloudBase in my Mini Program app.js.
Write a cloud function that returns the current user's openid.
Test if Mini Program authentication works.
say_en.note: Claude gives test cloud function and call code.
